key_fields.name: YYYY-STORE-PFKEY
key_fields.meaning: Maps EIBAID to the CCARD-AID condition names of CVCRD01Y: Enter, Clear, PA1, PA2, PF1-PF12, and PF13-PF24 folded onto PF1-PF12.

key_fields.name: YYYY-STORE-PFKEY-EXIT
key_fields.meaning: Exit paragraph closing the PERFORM ... THRU range.

observations.text: The EVALUATE has no WHEN OTHER: any other AID (for example a light-pen or Clear-partition key) leaves CCARD-AID unchanged from the INITIALIZE done by the caller (Inferred).

purpose: Procedure-division copybook holding paragraph YYYY-STORE-PFKEY and its exit. It translates the CICS attention identifier EIBAID into CCARD-AID values, treating PF13-PF24 as PF1-PF12. COACTUPC copies it at the end of its procedure division and performs it in 0000-MAIN before deciding which keys are valid; the same copybook is used by the other card/account online programs.
